players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck and Moderna Announce Phase 3 INTerpath-001 Trial of (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Merck and Moderna announced positive topline results of the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial: at a pre-specified interim analysis, adjuvant intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) plus KEYTRUDA met the primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival and the key secondary endpoint of distant metastasis-free survival versus KEYTRUDA alone in completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma, with safety consistent with prior studies; the trial continues to evaluate overall survival. The companies call it the first positive Phase 3 readout for an individualized neoantigen therapy and for an mRNA-based cancer therapy, will present the data at an international medical meeting and will engage regulators on filings; the INTerpath program has nine Phase 2 and Phase 3 trials across melanoma, NSCLC, bladder and renal cancer.
